name: Programmable logic controller (PLC)
short_description: An industrial controller that runs the local machine sequence of production equipment, handling its steps and conditions in response to inputs.

evidence.quote: The filler has its own programmable logic controller, or PLC.
Then the IoT layer, sensors, PLCs, gateways, machine signals, sees the physical event.
The conveyor motor has a temperature sensor and the PLC sees the temperature rise
while the PLCs run the actual control logic close to the equipment.
The PLC raised the alarm, OPC UA is connected.
